Top Mechanical Keyboards Under ₹3,000 (Hot-Swappable)
Detailed Options
Ajazz AK680 WirelessGo to product viewer dialog for this item.: This compact 65% layout keyboard saves desk space while keeping dedicated arrow keys. It supports tri-mode connectivity (rare at this price point) and features 3-pin hot-swappable mechanical switches that you can replace without soldering. Prices usually hover around ₹2,500 – ₹2,900.
Evofox RoninGo to product viewer dialog for this item.: A popular local contender offering 5-pin hot-swap compatibility, meaning it fits a wider variety of custom switches than standard 3-pin boards. It also includes a budget gasket mount design for a softer typing sound and feel.
Redragon K617 FizzGo to product viewer dialog for this item.: A sturdy 60% wired mini keyboard. It features bright RGB backlighting, decent out-of-the-box linear or tactile switches, and basic 3-pin hot-swappability backed by accessible companion software.
